da11eb9a55a35a73.description: Product Manager - Technical (SaaS / Enterprise Applications) Location: Hyderabad, India Employment Type: Full-time About the RoleWe're looking for a product manager with strong technical depth and a customer-first mindset to help drive our SaaS enterprise application roadmap. You'll work closely with engineering, sales, and customers to translate business needs into scalable, AI-native product solutions.
